'''2006 World Championship Day 3 Steven Lewis DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis (2006-10-31).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35771 MKOS - Lewis Style]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071220025759/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35771 Internet Archive]</ref>
